descriptionChirho: A Horite clan chief listed among the sons of Seir in the genealogies of Genesis 36 and 1 Chronicles 1. The name is consistently rendered as Dishon across translations: eng 'Dishon', spa 'Dison/Dishon', hin 'dishon', arb 'dishun', kor 'dison', swa 'Dishoni'. Six occurrences cover both direct naming and conjunctive forms (and-Dishon).

A distinct Horite clan chief, son of Seir, listed separately from Dishon in the genealogy of Genesis 36:21, 28 and 1 Chronicles 1:38, 42. Translations consistently differentiate this name from Dishon: eng 'Dishan', spa 'Disan', hin 'dishan', arb 'dishan', kor 'disan', swa 'Dishani'. The vowel pattern difference marks a separate individual in the genealogical tradition.
